format.note: 2026-27 Transfermarkt: 11 clubs, 10 rounds, then 6/5; the old 14-club Phase I row was the previous season.

playoff.entries: top two of each Phase I group into Phase II Group 1
playoff.note: Phase II Group 1 decides the promoted clubs; the official Liga 1 summary states the top two go up.

boundaries.note: Super Liga Phase I bottom two (7th and 8th) are relegated straight into Liga 1 Phase II; Liga 1 promotes its top two. No play-off.

conflicts.note: The Liga 1 infobox says 12 clubs, but the 2026-27 participant list and Phase I groups (6 + 5) have 11. Used 11 for the season.

notes: Moldova runs an August-May season (27 June 2026 - 22 May 2027 for the Super Liga). Super Liga: 8 clubs, Phase I is 21 rounds (each pair twice, then a third meeting), then the top six play Phase II over 10 more matches with Phase I points halved and rounded down; the bottom two are relegated after Phase I and do not play Phase II. Liga 1: 11 clubs in two geographic groups (A 6, B 5), then Phase II split into Group 1 (the top two of each group) and Group 2. Below Liga 1 is Liga 2, not modelled; MDL2 is closed_down in our data for that reason.
